headline: IMF releases final $371 million of $3 billion Ghana loan program
summary: The International Monetary Fund has disbursed the final $371 million tranche of its $3 billion Extended Credit Facility for Ghana.
why: The IMF provides financial assistance to countries facing balance-of-payments difficulties to stabilize their economies and restore sustainable growth.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: The final disbursement supports fiscal stability and debt management efforts.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The completion of the loan program signals improved fiscal discipline and provides liquidity to the Ghanaian economy.
